scope: Independent publication integration review only. Full original-question and correction content reviews are preserved from their actual prior reviewers; not re-performed or claimed here.
method: Read AGENTS.md and the content/FP publication contracts. Reviewed publication docs, source attribution and test changes.

Compared all 60 public question objects to accepted delivery, requiring only enrichment draft to reviewed change. Recomputed canonical JSON SHA256 and normalized hashes; validated each actual initial/correction review author, reviewer, time and accepted draft hash.
Read actual stored review records rather than inventing new content verification. Three corrected records retain version2; other57 retain version1, official answers unchanged.
Validated all original PDF and referenced figure hashes and sourceRecord membership. Compared generated pack to all60 normalized authored records and checked manifest/index/pack/offline hashes.
Verified source attribution, objective default and exactly one objective60 study target. Practical subjects all unavailable, no diagnostic/mock/card feature artificially added.
Compared 3243 existing AP/AB authored/generated corpus and source/figure files byte-for-byte to origin/main. Inspected release-only shell changes.

Executed tests/fp2-content.py including real60 acceptance and isolated negative/synthetic contracts, tools/check-fp2-delivery.py . --reviewed, and git diff --check. All passed. Expected negative fixture error traces do not indicate failed assertions.
limitations: No live Pages deployment verification or new browser execution performed by this integration reviewer; parent performs these. Current-law verification is not a requirement for these past questions; all retain original2025-04-01 basis and unverified current-law metadata.

baselineQualificationInvestigation.baselineResult: fails identically at tests/qualifications.py line97 after fixture second-pack addition
baselineQualificationInvestigation.cause: Mutable manifest requests return saved cache immediately and refresh network in background (sw.js refreshInBackground); first reload intentionally reads prior manifest. Fixture test assumed synchronous network refresh. Existing tests/pwa.py already waits for cached manifest SHA after triggering refresh.
baselineQualificationInvestigation.minimalFix: Test-only helper after each of three fixture rebuilds: fetch mutable fixture-a manifest to trigger refresh; wait_for_async until Cache Storage contains expected index SHA from newly built manifest; then reload. No arbitrary sleeps or app-code changes.
baselineQualificationInvestigation.probeResult: full baseline qualifications UI test passes with three refresh waits, including retire/history snapshots, unsaved-plan protection, storage failures and offline switching
baselineQualificationInvestigation.status: baseline test-race confirmed; test synchronization fix proven
